currentPain: equities research buyers need SOC 2/vendor-risk answers, supervisory proof, and retention evidence before adopting AI-assisted research workflows today
futureAssumption: AI-assisted research will move from pilot to routine production, making automated control evidence and auditor-ready proof a buying requirement within six months

readiness.demoNarrative: show the draft, the AI-risk findings, the supervisor decision, the retained manifest, then this SOC/vendor-risk evidence map generated from the same ledger

controls.title: AI-assisted research pre-publication review evidence is captured before distribution
controls.currentPain: research supervisors need fast proof that analysts did not publish AI-assisted claims without review
controls.futurePain: AI-assisted research volume will make sample-based manual review inadequate within six months
controls.soc1Objective: Controls provide evidence that research output changes and review packets are complete before client distribution.

controls.title: Supervisor/compliance approval is independent from the submitting analyst
controls.currentPain: buyers need to show AI-assisted research had human supervision, not analyst self-certification
controls.futurePain: research teams using copilots will need scalable segregation-of-duty evidence for exceptions and high-risk findings
controls.soc1Objective: Controls restrict research approval to authorized reviewers independent of the preparer.

controls.title: Research supervision ledger integrity is tamper-evident
controls.currentPain: compliance teams need to trust the audit trail after a disputed AI-assisted recommendation
controls.futurePain: agentic research workflows will require rollback/rewrite detection, not editable spreadsheets of approvals
controls.soc1Objective: Controls detect unauthorized changes to research supervision records.

controls.title: SEC/FINRA books-and-records retention export is manifest-backed
controls.currentPain: enterprise buyers ask whether AI review evidence can be retained, exported, and placed under legal hold
controls.futurePain: procurement and compliance reviews will expect WORM/object-lock handoff proof before approving AI research tools
controls.soc1Objective: Controls evidence completeness of retained research books-and-records exports.

controls.title: AI model usage inventory and model-risk flags are generated from review packets
controls.currentPain: model-risk teams need to know which approved or unapproved AI models touched research drafts before publication
controls.futurePain: AI governance reviews will expect model usage inventories linked to immutable supervision evidence, not analyst self-attestation
controls.soc1Objective: Controls evidence approved model usage and escalation of model-risk exceptions in the research workflow.

controls.title: Control evidence map is generated from product evidence, not policy prose
controls.currentPain: SOC 2 and vendor-risk questionnaires create sales friction when answers are detached from system evidence
controls.futurePain: AI governance buyers will prefer products that generate auditor-facing evidence automatically during workflow execution
controls.soc1Objective: Controls provide repeatable evidence for management review and service-organization reporting.
